verdict.rationale: Alloy publishes an llms.txt docs index at /public/llms.txt, which it explicitly advertises for AI agents. It also serves per-page .md mirrors with per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments, and the llms.txt contents are evidenced by indexed doc entries. The probe 404 is at the root /llms.txt path, a different location, so it does not contradict the /public/llms.txt file. Missing for 10: llms.txt at the conventional root path (root returns 404), independent hands-on corroboration of agents consuming the index.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
